decision_conditions: Condition 2 of planning permission reference 26131/APP/2024/2245, dated 15/04/2025, is amended to:
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on Drawing Numbers:
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020), and the London Plan (2021).

Notwithstanding the non-material amendment hereby approved, other than Condition 2, which is superseded by the above condition, all other conditions relating to Planning Permission Ref 26131/APP/2024/2245, dated 15/04/2025 must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.

description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 26131/APP/2024/2245, dated 15/04/2025 (Change of use of function room to public accessible gym) for the relocation of Male/Female changing room, Disabled and Unisex toilet, Fire exit, Reception area, Removal of Office, and Adding a Posing Room.
